story.iWant: a sovereign ingestion pipeline with automated trust scoring
story.soThat: all data entering Jarvis is classified, weighted, and provenance-controlled before it can influence cognition, governance, or memory

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Raw data passes through controlled pipeline with provenance tracking. Pipeline supports batch ingestion for PDFs, CSV, JSON, Logs, Research papers. Every ingestion produces: ingestion_id, raw_hash, source_uri, timestamp, initial_tier=0. Ingestion as controlled projection: Π_ingest: RawData → (K, P, c₀). No ingestion may bypass Tier Assignment or Provenance Ledger (11-5).

Data item receives trust score (0.0-1.0) based on: source reputation, cryptographic integrity, structural consistency, cross-source corroboration, historical accuracy, reviewer confidence. Scoring function: c₀(i) = BaseTrust(Tier(i)) · SourceReputation(o). Base trust values: K₀=1.00, K₁=0.95, K₂=0.80, K₃=0.50, K₄=0.20. Recommendation: {quarantine, provisional, authoritative}.

Tier 0 → Tier 1 automatic if score ≥ 0.5. Tier 1 → Tier 2 requires human reviewer OR governance auto-policy. Every promotion creates new Epistemic Ledger version. Trust weight bumped on promotion. Full forensic trail logged. Promotion tied to 11-5 dual-persona arbitration.

Blocks: malformed datasets, statistical outliers as sole sources, single-origin authority inflation. Detects: mirroring attacks, dataset hallucination, citation loops. Pre-tier filters: structural validity, source authenticity, intent surface scan. Quarantine on filter failure. Integrated with C-IDS (11-4).

Every ingested item must declare: knowledge_class, declared_source_type. Mismatch detection: "news" declaring "primary_evidence" → forced Tier 0. Class binding enforced before ledger entry. Integration with 11-5 knowledge tier model.

Batch processing with parallel ingestion, backpressure management, per-batch trust distribution. Batch risk scoring: Risk(B) = (1/|B|) · Σ(i ∈ B)(1 - c₀(i)). If Risk(B) > θ ⇒ Batch throttled, sandboxed, or delayed. Abort threshold if %low_trust > X.
BMAD can: read Tier 1 & 2, weigh decisions by trust score. BMAD cannot: promote Tier 1 → 2, override trust scoring, bypass ingestion firewall, inject data directly into ledger.

constraints.constraint: Story 11-6 builds on Story 11-5 (Epistemic Ledger). Must use existing tier lattice (K0-K4), provenance ledger, and dual-persona arbitration. All ingested data must flow through 11-5 components.
Ingestion firewall is the LAST DEFENSE against knowledge poisoning. Must integrate with C-IDS (11-4) for attack pattern detection. Failed firewall checks MUST quarantine data, NEVER proceed.
Trust scores are immutable at creation. Only promotions (Tier 0→1, 1→2) can bump trust. No backdoor promotions. Every promotion logged in epistemic audit (11-5).
Batch ingestion must handle 100+ documents with <2s trust evaluation. Use async processing, parallel scoring. Backpressure prevents memory exhaustion.
BMAD ingestion binding enforces read-only access for Tier 1-2. BMAD cannot bypass ingestion pipeline. All BMAD queries must respect tier restrictions.

tests.standards: All ingestion sovereignty components must have ≥90% test coverage. Unit tests for: trust scoring algorithms, tier assignment, firewall validation, batch risk analysis. Integration tests for: end-to-end ingestion flow (raw → Tier 0 → scored → promoted), firewall blocking malicious data, C-IDS integration, BMAD access restrictions.

ideas.idea: Test ingestion pipeline: PDF → parsed → provenance created → Tier 0. Verify ingestion_id uniqueness, raw_hash integrity.
Test trust scoring: telemetry (K0) → score=1.0, news (K3) → score=0.5, scrape (K4) → score=0.2. Test source reputation weighting.
Test promotion: Tier 0 → 1 automatic (score ≥0.5), Tier 1 → 2 requires human approval. Verify ledger versioning, audit trail.
Test firewall: malformed JSON → quarantine, citation loop → block, statistical outlier → flag. Verify C-IDS integration.
Test class binding: news claiming "primary_evidence" → forced K4. Verify mismatch detection.
Test batch ingestion: 100 docs → risk score, high-risk batch → throttled. Test backpressure, abort threshold.
Test BMAD binding: BMAD reads Tier 1-2, cannot promote, cannot bypass firewall. Verify access denial logs.
